Bumps the eslint group with 4 updates in the / directory: [@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin](https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/tree/HEAD/packages/eslint-plugin), [@typescript-eslint/parser](https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/tree/HEAD/packages/parser), [eslint](https://github.com/eslint/eslint) and [eslint-plugin-unicorn](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn). Updates `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin` from 8.71.0 to 8.71.2
Release notes

Sourced from @​typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin's releases.

v8.71.2

8.71.2 (2026-10-12)

🩹 Fixes

  • eslint-plugin: [no-unused-vars] avoid false-positives when not using our parser (#12989)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unnecessary-type-parameters] count instantiated mapped type templates (#12974)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unused-vars] ignore type-only refs for after-used (#12977)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unnecessary-type-parameters] parenthesize constraint in optional tuple elements (#12995)
  • eslint-plugin: [prefer-optional-chain] safe fix when the chain ends with a strict null comparison (#12805)
  • type-utils: match linked packages and packages with missing version in TypeOrValueSpecifier (#12948)

❤️ Thank You

  • Evyatar Daud @​StyleShit
  • Josh Goldberg
  • Vinccool96
  • Younsang Na @​nayounsang

See GitHub Releases for more information.

You can read about our versioning strategy and releases on our website.

v8.71.1

8.71.1 (2026-10-05)

🩹 Fixes

  • eslint-plugin: [no-misused-promises] skip argument checks for calls without arguments (#12923)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unused-vars] report usedOnlyAsType for partially exported merged declarations (#12892)
  • eslint-plugin: [require-array-sort-compare] use array argument type constraint (#12919)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unsafe-enum-assignment] skip identical types and bound deep type walks (#12957)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-confusing-void-expression] don't autofix when declared return type is unknown (#12930)
  • eslint-plugin: [prefer-optional-chain] check the constrained type (#12953)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unnecessary-type-parameters] count instantiated mapped type constraints (#12941)
  • project-service: throttle cleanup when opening files (#12934)
  • type-utils: match re-exports and global declarations in TypeOrValueSpecifier (#12943)

Updates `eslint` from 10.11.0 to 10.12.0
Release notes

Sourced from eslint's releases.

v10.12.0

Features

  • 4618052 feat: handle astral letters in new-cap (#21357) (sary)
  • 4ec5168 feat: allow SourceCode#getText() to accept tokens and comments (#21340) (electrohyun)

Bug Fixes

  • bc51eee fix: prefer-arrow-callback false positive in conditional test (#21373) (Daniel Pinto)
  • bbff86c fix: skip lines with multiple comments in max-lines-per-function (#21332) (xbinaryx)
  • efc4d6b fix: astral letters in consistent-return, no-eval, no-invalid-this (#21360) (lumir)
  • 93de066 fix: prefer-exponentiation-operator autofix for async function base (#21322) (Vladimir Babin)
  • 02e34ff fix: add missing space after else in curly autofix (#21355) (Pixel)
  • b14b8bc fix: correct id-length message for long private names (#21348) (Pixel)
  • 69aac01 fix: support TSFunctionType in getFunctionHeadLoc (#21335) (xbinaryx)
  • 686630e fix: no-loss-of-precision false positive with 0.e5 (#21337) (sethamus)

Documentation

  • 67eb586 docs: Update README (GitHub Actions Bot)
  • 5370d7e docs: clarify one-var separateRequires matches any require() call (#21192) (sethamus)
  • 8816c1d docs: Update README (GitHub Actions Bot)
  • 3d2e7ce docs: fix typo in no-unused-expressions documentation (#21346) (bytedoe)

Chores

  • 152067f chore: update ecosystem plugins (#21362) (ESLint Bot)
  • b56d58e chore: update github/codeql-action action to v4.38.2 (#21376) (renovate[bot])
  • bfaea12 perf: cache normalized config globals per languageOptions (#21364) (James Ross)
  • 322209e ci: avoid Nx cache in ecosystem tests and disable failing test (#21369) (Francesco Trotta)
  • d166567 chore: update dependency prettier to v3.9.9 (#21371) (renovate[bot])

  • f995127 chore: remove CLAUDE.md in favor of AGENTS.md (#21339) (Jarren)
  • b95fb6c chore: update dependency prettier to v3.9.7 (#21347) (renovate[bot])

Updates `eslint-plugin-unicorn` from 76.0.0 to 78.0.0
Release notes

Sourced from eslint-plugin-unicorn's releases.

v78.0.0

New rules

  • no-unnecessary-default-arguments (#3885) 1059f09b
  • no-repeated-call-wrappers (#3836) c4fd1feb

Improvements

  • Add SOML support, including a recommended-soml preset (#3870) 7419b835
  • Report code that contains comments instead of ignoring it (#3847) 003f0bdc
    • Many rules skipped code with comments. They now report it, and only withhold fixes that would remove comments. You may see new reports.
  • Fix cyclic resolution in type-aware checks (#3826) 5e77e19e
  • prefer-default-parameters: Add checkFallbackExpressions option (#3837) 71bbf59a
  • prefer-ternary: Add checkVaryingBase and checkComputedMemberAccess options (#3869) 1af3c2b2
  • consistent-boolean-name: Allow does prefix by default (#3853) cfad028d
  • consistent-boolean-name: Recognize promise-returning functions (#3879) 769e3b87
  • consistent-boolean-name: Fix cyclic type parameter resolution (#3821) 5c4808ba
  • no-asterisk-prefix-in-documentation-comments: Remove shared indentation (#3820) a92aee19
  • no-await-in-promise-methods: Clarify the message for nested await (#3867) 8f73d539
  • no-immediate-mutation: Combine a declaration with an assignment that follows it immediately (#3851) 811e4678
  • no-negated-condition: Support && and || chains of negated operands (#3834) 15bfade7
  • no-top-level-side-effects: Allow known pure imported helpers, like defineConfig() and React memo(), and check default-exported expressions (#3822) 3826236d
  • no-unnecessary-parameters: Fix false positive for recursive defaults (#3844) e2d8d0ff
  • no-unnecessary-parameters: Ignore parameters named by type predicates (#3859) f0c631ce
  • no-using-resource-escape: Check TypeScript instantiation expressions (#3833) 7a9f7df1
  • prefer-at: Fix false positives for DOM collections (#3842) ca78a7aa
  • prefer-combined-guards: Combine non-literal exits in TypeScript when type information is available (#3860) 2bcc7be6
  • prefer-default-parameters: Support static template literal fallbacks (#3835) 3d8b40a5
  • prefer-default-parameters: Support fallbacks to earlier bindings (#3840) d4bfc1cf
  • prefer-default-parameters: Handle nullable fallback types (#3858) d75786f7
  • prefer-early-return, prefer-continue: Suggest opposite relational comparisons (#3873) de2e6daa
  • prefer-logical-operator-over-ternary: Handle non-boolean conditions (#3843) 5c4d50cf
  • prefer-minimal-ternary: Ignore formatting differences in shared expressions (#3841) b0c21423
  • prefer-minimal-ternary: Prevent unsafe TypeScript object autofixes (#3846) 2f33c916
  • prefer-observer-apis: Check let and var listener functions, and ignore reassigned listeners (#3833) 7a9f7df1
  • prefer-private-class-fields: Do not autofix reassigned methods, and suggest private arrow functions for bound methods (#3823) 6f0f4bb8
  • prefer-scoped-selector: Ignore queries on more non-element roots, like ownerDocument and getRootNode() (#3833) 7a9f7df1
  • prefer-spread: Prevent unsafe TypeScript autofixes (#3882) 21e99ff8
  • prefer-ternary: Support destructuring assignments (#3852) e29d1eee
  • prefer-ternary: Support statements that differ in only one part, like call(test ? a : b) (#3869) 1af3c2b2
  • prefer-top-level-await: Allow cached promise assignments (#3819) 2fb8eb60
  • prefer-top-level-await: Avoid false positives on non-promise calls (#3883) 3f125f14
  • relative-url-style: Support complex Markdown labels, embedded HTML in Markdown, JSX, URL.canParse(), URL.parse(), and more HTML attributes (#3854) 2760ce46
  • require-module-specifiers: Allow bare export {} in declaration files (#3866) e7274810
  • template-indent: Ignore templates with content on the opening line (#3868) 921dd8c3
